map.gps.none: No GPS found. Without GPS: search for a street, address or place you can see around you.

mobil.android.step2: Open Settings and search for certificate. Choose Install a certificate, then CA certificate (the name varies between phones) and pick the file {file}.
mobil.android.step3: (Android usually cannot find the .local name, so the address with numbers.)
mobil.android.title: Set up an Android phone
mobil.cert.note: The certificate only works for addresses in your own home network (names ending in .local and network numbers like 192.168…). It cannot be used for ordinary websites on the internet. You can remove it at any time: on an iPhone under Settings, General, VPN and Device Management.
mobil.intro: A phone only shows your position on the map when the page is opened securely (https). Set it up once per phone. After that it works without internet, with the phone's own GPS.
mobil.ios.step1: Safari asks whether to download a profile: tap Allow.
mobil.ios.step2: Open Settings. At the top it says Profile Downloaded: tap it, then Install, and enter the phone's passcode.
mobil.ios.step3: Go to Settings, General, About, and at the bottom Certificate Trust Settings. Turn on {kit} on {name}.
mobil.ios.step4: Open this address. You can add it to the home screen (Share, Add to Home Screen).
mobil.ios.title: Set up an iPhone
mobil.lending.keepernote: This is the Kit Mac's switch. It can be turned on and off only here, on the Kit Mac itself. Turning it off erases any position that was lent.
mobil.lending.off: Lending is off. The Kit Mac does not accept positions from phones.
mobil.lending.on: Lending is on. Phones on the Wi-Fi can send the Kit Mac their position.
mobil.lending.title: Lending a position
mobil.lending.visitornote: Lending is turned on only at the Kit Mac itself. Ask the person who runs the Kit Mac (the Keeper) to turn it on.
mobil.nocert: The kit has no https certificate yet. Restart it on the Kit Mac.
mobil.ready.text: Open the map and tap ⌖ at the top right. Allow location access when the phone asks.
mobil.ready.title: Done: this phone can show your position
mobil.share.denied: Location access was denied. Allow location for this page in the phone's settings.
mobil.share.refused: The Kit Mac did not accept the position: lending is off. It is turned on only at the Kit Mac itself. Ask the person who runs the Kit Mac to turn it on.
mobil.share.searching: Looking for a GPS signal… Go outside or stand by a window.
mobil.share.sharing: Position sent to the Kit Mac (±{metres} m, {time}). Keep this page open.
mobil.share.start: Lend my position to the Kit Mac
mobil.share.text: The Kit Mac has no GPS of its own. Let the phone send its position, and the Kit Mac's map shows where you are when you tap ⌖ there. Keep this page open and the screen on while you lend. It only works when lending is turned on at the Kit Mac.
mobil.share.title: The phone as the Kit Mac's GPS
mobil.share.unreachable: Cannot reach the Kit Mac. Is the phone on the same Wi-Fi, and is the kit running?
mobil.title: Phone GPS
mobil.without.text: Open the phone's Compass app (iPhone) or a map app that shows coordinates, and type them into the map's search box, for example 50.4501, 30.5234. Organic Maps on the phone also has GPS and works entirely without the Kit Mac.
mobil.without.title: Without setup
